cards.card_text: Act wisely toward outsiders, Paul says, and then he gets to how they talk: always gracious, seasoned with salt.
cards.verse_text: Act wisely toward outsiders, redeeming the time. Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how to answer everyone.

cards.card_text: Paul wants their speech always gracious and seasoned with salt.
